description: Covers the red tests compiler2_runtime_demand_preserves_reducer_surface_when_suspend_continuation_escapes, compiler2_transport_plan_preserves_enumerable_suspend_continuation_captures, and compiler2_abi_ready_keeps_returned_suspend_continuation_callable_entry. Likely root cause: the semantic closure for a returned Enumerable.reduce suspend continuation does not close the required reducer/continuation activation before runtime demand, transport, and ABI-ready inventory consume it. The unresolved frontier waits on an activation like FunctionId(67) with reducer-shaped inputs. Fix at the earliest semantic/transport contract that proves the missing activation; do not compensate in ABI/native by inventing callable entries.
title: Artifact seam: close suspend continuation callable frontier before transport
